## Write-ups

- [Designing retrieval and code review for a data-engineering agent](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/agent-retrieval/): How an agent that writes PySpark, SQL and dbt code finds the right tables and checks its own code, and the design choices behind each step.
- [Testing LLMs and Databricks platforms for regulated use](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/llm-evaluation/): How two products qualify LLMs and Databricks platforms for regulated (GxP) use: test engines, evidence an auditor can read, generated tests and signing.
- [ReadableSTEM turns STEM PDFs into accessible pages](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/readablestem/): How ReadableSTEM turns STEM PDFs and LaTeX source into accessible web pages: two models, checks against the PDF, instructor review, a sandbox and capped spend.
- [Evaluating ReadableSTEM with tests registered before they ran](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/readablestem-evaluation/): Registered tests of ReadableSTEM: the newest equation set, how the equation score came about, handwriting, tables and chemistry, and what was missed.
- [Margins, a study app that makes you try before it helps](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/margins/): How Margins plans study from a student’s own files and makes them try first: its learner model, a tutor that withholds answers, voice teach-back and its limits.
- [Holdbrief: a daily read on every stock you own](https://harishmanoharan.com/work/holdbrief/): How Holdbrief works: ranking, valuation and a fair zone computed by code, a language model that only explains them behind a checker, and a public track record.

## Projects

- [ReadableSTEM](https://readablestem.com/): An open-source tool that turns STEM course PDFs, and LaTeX source, into accessible web pages, live as a free beta that anyone can sign in to. It also reads scanned and handwritten pages from their image, sending every equation it reads there to review.
  Source: https://github.com/harishm17/readablestem
- [Margins](https://studymargins.com/): A study app that makes you try before it helps. From your own course files it plans each day to your exam date and takes you through warm-up, reading, recall, practice and a quiz. Mastery counts only the answers you gave without help, and its tutor holds back the answer, which I test with scripted students who try to get it. Free, with Google sign-in.
  Source: https://github.com/harishm17/margins
- [Holdbrief](https://holdbrief.com/): An open-source daily brief on the stocks you follow, for US and Indian markets, with a read-only live demo and sign-in by invitation. After each close it ranks every company against its market’s peers, values the price around a fair zone that widens with uncertainty, and picks Keep, Watch closely or Reconsider by fixed, versioned rules. A language model only writes the explanation, and a checker rejects any sentence that cites a fact not in the data. Each view is logged and graded later against the index.
  Source: https://github.com/harishm17/holdbrief

## Earlier internships

- Digitus Business Solutions, Software engineer intern, 2024: Four projects for the sales, support, legal and finance teams: an agent, a RAG assistant, a drafting tool and an ERP integration.
- PwC India, Technology consulting intern, data analytics, 2023: Built a customer analytics platform, served to the client team through Django REST APIs and Power BI: demand forecasting with an XGBoost and SARIMA ensemble using seasonality and promotion features, market basket analysis, customer segmentation and sentiment analysis of more than 30,000 reviews to find what drove satisfaction and churn.
